images.alt: Poster-style image of a letter over a background of boats on the water with flags. The large green text addresses a government minister, urging New Zealand to uphold international law and condemn Israel’s interception of the Global Sumud Flotilla. It mentions New Zealand citizens on board, calls for accountability and sanctions, and is signed “Chlöe Swarbrick, Green Party Co-leader,” with authorisation text at the bottom.
